projects.title: Blinking LED
projects.fun_fact: LEDs were invented in 1962 and the first ones could only glow red!
steps: Place an LED on the breadboard. Long leg = positive (+), short leg = negative (-).
Connect the long leg of the LED to Arduino pin 13 using a jumper wire.
Connect the short leg to GND through a 220Ω resistor.
Open Wokwi and upload the Blink example code to make the LED flash.
Watch the video: How to Blink an LED with Arduino (Wokwi Tutorial).

projects.title: Temperature Control with Potentiometer & LCD
projects.fun_fact: The first LCD displays were invented in the 1960s and were originally used in digital watches!
steps: Place a potentiometer on the breadboard and connect the middle pin to A0.
Connect the LCD with I2C module to SDA and SCL pins on the Arduino.
Connect VCC and GND of both the LCD and potentiometer.
Use analogRead() to read the potentiometer value.
Convert the value to temperature using map().
Display the temperature on the LCD.
Watch the video: Arduino Temperature Control Using Potentiometer & LCD.

projects.title: Traffic Light System
projects.fun_fact: The first electric traffic light was installed in 1914 in Cleveland, Ohio!
steps: Place 3 LEDs on the breadboard: Red at the top, Yellow in the middle, Green at the bottom.
Connect the long legs of the LEDs to pins 13 (Red), 12 (Yellow), and 11 (Green).
Connect the short legs of all LEDs to GND using resistors.
Write code that turns on Red → waits → Yellow → waits → Green → waits.
Upload the code in Wokwi to see your traffic light system in action.
Watch the video: Build a Traffic Light System using Arduino (Wokwi).
